quote: determined that Genting New York LLC (herein "Resorts World New York City"), is suitable and not disqualified for licensure pursuant to New York Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law ("PML") §§ 1321-g and 1321-h (incorporating§§ 1317 and 1318, respectively) and meets the minimum license thresholds set forth in PML § 1321-f (incorporating§ 1316) and Resorts World New York City having agreed to execute a monitoring agreement as set forth in the Commission's motion of December 15, 2025, has issued the enclosed Gaming Facility License Award.

claim: Resorts World New York City's gaming facility license lasts 15 years from the Commission's issuance of an operation certificate and is thereafter renewable for 10 years.
reason: This passage is from the issued license award itself and states a concrete license term: duration is 15 years from issuance of the operation certificate, renewable for 10 years. That is a substantive project/license term, not a recommendation or boilerplate.
quote: License Duration: 15 years from the Commission's issuance of an operation certificate to Resorts World New York City pursuant to Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law § 1331, renewable thereafter for a period of 10 years.

claim: Resorts World New York City shall materially perform consistent with the content of its Application and commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process, as determined or otherwise approved by the Commission.
reason: In the license conditions, Resorts World New York City “shall materially perform consistent with the content of its Application and commitments,” which is a binding project-performance obligation.
quote: Resorts World New York City shall materially perform consistent with the content of its Application and commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process, as determined or otherwise approved by the Commission.

claim: Resorts World New York City shall pay, on or before December 31, 2025, a $500,000,000 gaming facility license fee by electronic funds transfer in accordance with Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law § 1321-e(3) and 9 NYCRR § 601.1(b).
reason: The license condition says Resorts World New York City “shall pay… a $500,000,000 gaming facility license fee” by a stated deadline, a clear binding payment duty.
quote: Resorts World New York City shall pay, on or before December 31, 2025, a $500,000,000 gaming facility license fee by electronic funds transfer in accordance with Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law§ 1321-e(3) and 9 NYC RR § 601.1 (b ).

claim: Resorts World New York City shall, on or before December 31, 2025, deposit via cash or bond an amount representing 5 percent of the total investment proposed in the Application, in accordance with Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law § 1321-e(1).
reason: License condition imposing a specific payment-security duty: deposit 5% of total proposed investment by December 31, 2025.
quote: Resorts World New York City shall, on or before December 31, 2025, deposit via cash or bond, an amount representing 5 percent of the total investment proposed in the Application, in accordance with Racing, Pari­ Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law § 1321-e( 1 ).

claim: Resorts World New York City shall establish milestones and budgets concerning the community benefits proposed in the Application and commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process.
reason: Documented license condition requiring project-specific milestones and budgets for proposed community benefits and CAC commitments.
quote: Resorts World New York City shall establish milestones and budgets concerning the community benefits proposed in the Application and commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process.

claim: Resorts World New York City shall post on its public website and submit to the Commission, for public dissemination without redaction, a community benefits progress report, including construction and operational workforce diversity and demographic data, at a frequency determined by the Commission.
reason: Binding reporting obligation in the license: post and submit community benefits progress reports with specified content.
quote: Resorts World New York City shall post on its public website and submit to the Commission, for public dissemination without redaction, a community benefits progress report, including, without limitation, construction and operational workforce diversity and demographic data, at a frequency determined by the Commission.

claim: Each community benefits progress report shall detail progress, set forth relevant budget and expenditure, and explain actual or anticipated delays in delivery of benefits proposed in the Application or Resorts World New York City's other commitments.
reason: This specifies required contents of the mandated community benefits progress report, including disclosure of delays in delivering proposed benefits.
quote: Each such report shall detail progress, set forth relevant budget and expenditure, and explain actual or anticipated delays in delivery of benefits proposed in the Application or Resorts World New York City's other commitments.

claim: Resorts World New York City shall commence gaming operations promptly upon the Commission's determination that the permanent casino area of the Gaming Facility has been completed in accordance with the Application, Article 13 of the Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law, and 9 NYCRR Part 5301.
reason: License condition requiring commencement of gaming operations once the Commission determines the permanent casino area is completed per the application and law.
quote: Resorts World New York City shall commence gaming operations promptly upon the Commission's determination that the permanent casino area of the Gaming Facility has been completed in accordance with the Application, Article 13 of the Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law, and 9 NYCRR Part 5301.

claim: Resorts World New York City shall comply in all material respects with third-party agreements included and/or proposed within the Application.
reason: Binding compliance condition requiring Resorts World New York City to comply in all material respects with third-party agreements in or proposed within the application.
quote: Compliance with Agreements Resorts World New York City shall comply in all material respects with third-party agreements included and/or proposed within the Application.

claim: All terms and conditions of the License are binding on Resorts World New York City and its Commission-approved successors and assigns.
reason: This passage states an operative license condition that all terms and conditions bind Resorts World New York City and Commission-approved successors and assigns. It is an accountability/binding condition in the license, so it should be retained.
quote: All of the terms and conditions of the License shall be binding upon Resorts World New York City and its Commission-approved successors and assigns.

claim: Under the required Compliance Monitoring Team arrangement, Resorts World New York City’s compliance reporting must cover the community benefits proposed in the Application and the commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process, including completion or delivery milestones.
reason: Specifies a required reporting topic under the CMT arrangement: "Community benefits proposed in the Application... including completion or delivery milestones."
quote: Community benefits proposed in the Application, and commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process, including completion or delivery milestones; and

reason: Binding duty in the license: Resorts World New York City "shall contract promptly with and compensate appropriately" an independent third-party CMT firm.
quote: To satisfy Resorts World New York City's obligation to accomplish the foregoing, Resorts World New York City shall contract promptly with and compensate appropriately an independent third-party CMT firm, proposed by Resorts World New York City and approved by the Commission, to monitor and report to the Commission, with notice to the board of directors of Resorts World New York City, as frequently as the Commission may request, on the ongoing compliance of Resorts World New York City with each of the elements of the Application and the regulatory obligations of Resorts World New York City, including, without limitation, the following topics, with the specifics and scope of the reporting with respect to each element to be approved by the Commission in the course of the Commission's consideration of approval of the contract and from time to time thereafter:

claim: Under the required Compliance Monitoring Team arrangement, Resorts World New York City’s compliance reporting must cover anti-money laundering compliance, including Know Your Customer, Suspicious Activity Report, and Currency Transition Report compliance.
reason: Required compliance-reporting scope is expressly listed: "Anti-money laundering compliance, including... Know Your Customer, Suspicious Activity Report, and Currency Transition Report compliance."
quote: Anti-money laundering compliance, including, without limitation, Know Your Customer, Suspicious Activity Report, and Currency Transition Report compliance;

claim: Under the required Compliance Monitoring Team arrangement, Resorts World New York City’s compliance reporting must cover compliance with any restrictions or requirements the Commission has set forth.
reason: Required CMT reporting topic is expressly stated: "Compliance monitoring with any restrictions or requirements the Commission has set forth."
quote: Compliance monitoring with any restrictions or requirements the Commission has set forth.

claim: Under the required Compliance Monitoring Team arrangement, Resorts World New York City’s compliance reporting must cover Commission regulatory requirements.
reason: License condition requires the CMT to monitor and report on Resorts World New York City's ongoing compliance with its regulatory obligations, expressly including 'Commission regulatory requirements.'
quote: To satisfy Resorts World New York City's obligation to accomplish the foregoing, Resorts World New York City shall contract promptly with and compensate appropriately an independent third-party CMT firm, proposed by Resorts World New York City and approved by the Commission, to monitor and report to the Commission, with notice to the board of directors of Resorts World New York City, as frequently as the Commission may request, on the ongoing compliance of Resorts World New York City with each of the elements of the Application and the regulatory obligations of Resorts World New York City, including, without limitation, the following topics, with the specifics and scope of the reporting with respect to each element to be approved by the Commission in the course of the Commission's consideration of approval of the contract and from time to time thereafter:

claim: The Compliance Monitoring Team firm engaged for this License shall be independent of Resorts World New York City’s auditors, legal counsel, and consultants for a minimum of five years prior to the engagement.
reason: This is a specific license requirement for the project: the CMT 'shall be independent' of RWNYC's auditors, counsel, and consultants for at least five years before engagement.
quote: Such CMT shall be independent of Resorts World New York City's auditors, legal counsel, and consultants, for a minimum of five years prior to the engagement.

claim: The contract between Resorts World New York City and the Compliance Monitoring Team shall be subject to the Commission’s prior approval, Resorts World New York City may not terminate that contract unilaterally or otherwise without the Commission’s prior written approval, and Resorts World New York City shall terminate the contract if directed by the Commission.
reason: The license imposes binding contract controls: Commission prior approval is required, RWNYC cannot terminate unilaterally without written approval, and it must terminate the CMT contract at the Commission's direction.
quote: The contract between the CMT and Resorts World New York City shall be subject to the prior approval of the Commission, Resorts World New York City shall not be permitted to terminate such contract unilaterally or otherwise without the prior written approval of the Commission, and Resorts World New York City shall terminate the contract with the CMT at the Commission's direction.

claim: An applicant must clearly state in its application that it shall meet the licensee deposit requirement.
reason: Substantive conditional financial obligation: the applicant/licensee must meet the licensee deposit requirement as a condition of licensure, not merely mention it. Compliance would be shown by satisfying the required deposit to the responsible authority.
quote: 3. meet the licensee deposit requirement;

claim: An applicant must clearly state in its application that it is able to pay and commits to paying the gaming licensing fee.
reason: Specific payment commitment to the commission/state: the applicant must be able to pay and commit to paying the gaming licensing fee. Compliance would be shown by payment of the required fee if licensed.
quote: 4. demonstrate that it is able to pay and shall commit to paying the gaming licensing fee;

claim: An applicant must clearly state in its application how it proposes to address problem gambling concerns, workforce development, community development, and host and nearby municipality impact and mitigation issues.
reason: This passage clearly requires the application to explain how the applicant proposes to address problem gambling, workforce, community, and municipal impacts, but it is less explicit that those proposed measures become binding delivery obligations. The clause contains substantive subject matter yet may govern proposal content only.
quote: 5. demonstrate to the commission how the applicant proposes to address problem gambling concerns, workforce development and community development and host and nearby municipality impact and mitigation issues;

claim: The Applicant must submit plans for procuring or generating on-site at least 10 percent of the gaming facility's annual electricity consumption from renewable energy sources qualified by NYSERDA.
reason: The passage clearly requires submission of a description of plans, but the candidate overstates it as a direct duty to procure or generate at least 10% renewable electricity. The source may imply a promised project feature if incorporated into the application, but the quoted text here is framed as a proposal-description requirement rather than an express binding performance term.
quote: Submit (.Electricity): A description of plans for procuring or generating on-site at least 10 percent of the facility's annual electricity consumption from renewable energy sources qualified by the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).

claim: The Applicant must propose a workforce training program for the gaming facility that establishes an on-site child day care program.
reason: Read with the surrounding workforce-development clause, the application must propose a workforce training program that includes establishing an on-site child day care program. This is a substantive promised workforce benefit for employees at the facility, not mere procurement administration. Compliance would be evidenced by establishment and maintenance of the on-site child care program if awarded.
quote: • establishes an on‐site child day care program.

claim: Any promises to the community made during the Community Advisory Committee process had to be recorded as amendments to the submitted application in order to be considered by the Board.
reason: This states a specific requirement governing project commitments: community promises “were required to be recorded as amendments to the respective submitted application in order to be considered by the Board.”
quote: Further, any promises to the community made as part of the Community Advisory Committee processes were required to be recorded as amendments to the respective submitted application in order to be considered by the Board.

Even though framed as a counterfactual and attributed to consultants, it is a material fiscal estimate relevant to planned implementation.

reason: This states the Board’s expectation that applicants’ represented hiring goals and requirements "be met," preserving the Board’s own conditional oversight position tied to project commitments.

claim: Resorts World estimates median compensation for full-time employees at about $150,000 per year including benefits.
reason: Project-specific compensation figure preserved at source certainty: "estimated near $150,000 annually, including benefits."
quote: Median compensation for full-time employees is estimated near $150,000 annually, including benefits.

claim: The Commission and Resorts World New York City stated a mutual intent to establish a third-party independent Compliance Monitoring Team in connection with the license to maintain financial integrity, enhance compliance and ethics programs, establish policies and procedures, prevent money laundering, and ensure delivery of promised public benefits.
reason: Documented license condition preserves the stated certainty: the parties "have a mutual intent" to establish an independent CMT in connection with the license.
quote: The Commission and Resorts World New York City have a mutual intent to maintain financial integrity, enhance compliance and ethics programs, establish policies and procedures, prevent money laundering, and ensure the delivery of promised public benefits by establishing a third-party independent Compliance Monitoring T earn ("CMT") in connection with this License.
